notes: Native gridded altimetry, including interpolated bins in the NASA source. Map orientation: north is negative game Z, east positive X. 4 degrees of latitude/longitude compressed into a 960 m game square; height differences multiplied by 0.015. The central base is flattened with a smooth transition. Rocks, sand and buildings are illustrative.
